name: brightspark-worker
description: Brightspark 11+ monetisation backend — magic-link auth, entitlement and Stripe. Separate dev-only sub-project; the static site stays zero-build and does not depend on this at build time.

scripts.deploy:staging: node scripts/check-config.mjs staging && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:prod: node scripts/check-config.mjs production && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.migrate:staging: node scripts/check-config.mjs staging && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env staging --remote
scripts.migrate:prod: node scripts/check-config.mjs production && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env production --remote
